about: Grid on a south polar stereographic map. Point (i, j) sits at x = x0_km + i * spacing_km, y = y0_km + j * spacing_km, where x = r sin(lon), y = r cos(lon) and r is the map distance from the pole. Values are stored row by row: index = j * n + i. null = outside the map.

horizons.about: Skyline for every non-null point, in the same row-by-row order. Each point has one 16-bit little-endian integer per direction: the terrain's elevation angle in hundredths of a degree, for azimuths 0, az_step_deg, 2 x az_step_deg, ...
